routes.label: Documents, PDFs, research, or recordings
routes.when: The immediate goal is processing supplied sources. A different requested deliverable keeps its own route and carries source context or a preparation prerequisite.

subtypes.when: Extract attributable facts, decisions, or notes from readable raw sources.
Synthesize a finished research report or literature review for a stated decision.
Improve navigation of a long Markdown or text document the project will keep and edit.

routes.label: A vague idea or research gap
routes.when: The owner wants to generate options, test an idea, or gather evidence before choosing the intended outcome.

subtypes.when: Generate possible directions before the owner chooses one.
Evaluate whether an existing idea is worth pursuing.
Gather new evidence before the owner decides what to do.

routes.label: A decision to make or a document to write
routes.when: The owner requests a decision or named document as the deliverable. A Product Brief handler fits only an approved Product Brief.

subtypes.when: Produce an explicitly requested Product Brief as the document deliverable.
Produce a Product Requirements Document.
Produce a PRFAQ or Business Requirements Document.
Deliver the requested design and experience specifications.
Deliver shared technical decisions in an architecture document.
Deliver a research artifact when the requested output is the research itself.
Deliver a document type with no more specific listed subtype, such as an operator guide.

routes.label: An obvious, low-risk edit
routes.when: The owner names an exact mechanical edit with an easy check. The native path requires an authorized, isolated code deliverable.

subtypes.when: Return an isolated corrected code artifact after an exact, low-risk mechanical edit.
Apply a mechanical edit directly to an existing worktree.

routes.label: A one-session change
routes.when: A clear implementation outcome fits one session. Existing repo and source facts may travel with it. A mixed native route requires a real Product Brief among the approved artifacts.

subtypes.when: Return a verified run-local code artifact for one implementation objective.
Return verified run-local code followed by its explicitly requested Product Brief.
Return code and a required document type that differs from a Product Brief.

routes.label: Work in an existing codebase
routes.when: The immediate goal is to establish or review repository context. A scoped implementation task carries existing-repo context on its sized route.

subtypes.when: Review or establish rules and context for working in an existing repository.

routes.label: One outcome, several sessions
routes.when: One coherent outcome needs multiple independently verifiable story builds.

subtypes.when: Deliver requirements and ordered stories for one coherent outcome.
Deliver the implemented and verified result across an epic's stories.

routes.label: Several epics or teams
routes.when: Several epics, teams, or shared decisions require initiative-level planning and coordination.

subtypes.when: Deliver shared requirements and an epic plan for multiple outcomes or teams.
Deliver integrated results and acceptance evidence across several epics.
